stories.title: Our guide to every NFL Week 11 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
stories.summary: Joe Burrow vs. Jayden Daniels. Fernando Mendoza vs. Bo Nix. There are 12 more games in Week 11, and we have picks, key stats and more for all of them.

stories.title: Rams' suspended Nacua needs MCL surgery, likely done for season
stories.summary: Rams receiver Puka Nacua, who is currently serving a three-game suspension while on IR, had surgery to repair his MCL and is likely done for the season.

stories.title: Rockies All-Star Goodman expected back for spring after shoulder surgery
stories.summary: Rockies All-Star catcher Hunter Goodman is expected to be ready for the spring after undergoing offseason surgery to clean up his left shoulder.

stories.title: Tide turned: DeBoer says this is most complete Bama team he's had
stories.summary: Alabama coach Kalen DeBoer said this is the most complete team he's had since taking over for Nick Saban prior to the 2024 season.

stories.title: Wemby debuts 'shunk,' part jump shot, part dunk done with reason
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama said his new-look "shunk" was done because of a blister former from actually dunking.
